headline: CABLE 🛠️ SLICED ✂️ by WORKERS 🧱 causes MASSIVE ✈️ AIRPORT 🛫 CHAOS 😵
text:
HUNDREDS ✈️ of FLIGHTS 🛫 got DELAYED ⏳ at MAJOR 🏙️ US ✈️ airports 🛬 after some CONSTRUCTION 🏗️ workers 🧱 ACCIDENTALLY 🔨 sliced ✂️ through a CRITICAL 📡 cable 🔌 needed 🛠️ for AIR 🛫 traffic 🧭 CONTROL 🎛️!! The SLIP 🛠️ UP 🆘 happened 🕒 during digging 🕳️ at a New 🗽 Jersey 📍 site 🏗️ and immediately 🚨 triggered 🌐 ground 🛑 STOPS 🛑 plus cascading ⛓️ delays 🕰️ across New 🗽 York ✈️ Pennsylvania 🏛️ New 🗽 Jersey 🗽 and Massachusetts 🦞 airports 🛬. Hours 🕒 later 🚨 the US 🦅 Transportation 🚉 Secretary 🧳 Sean 🧔 Duffy 🧔 announced 📢 the cable 🔌 had been fully 🛠️ repaired 🔧 and airports 🛬 would resume 🟢 normal 🧭 operations 🛫 though lingering 🕒 delays ⏳ were still expected 😩. This east 🧭 coast 🌊 mess 🍝 hit 😣 right before the massive 🤝 UN 🕊️ General 🏛️ Assembly 🗣️ in New 🗽 York 🗽 City 🌆 with world 🌍 leaders 👔 flying ✈️ in including UK 🇬🇧 Prime 👑 Minister 👔 Andy 🧔 Burnham 🧔 who luckily 🍀 boarded 🛫 his flight ✈️ BEFORE ⏰ the chaos 🌀 struck ⚡ and landed 🛬 as planned 📅!! "We were just SITTING 🪑 on the tarmac 🛣️ with ZERO 📵 updates 📡" one passenger 🧳 complained 😤 while the whole ordeal 🍆 left 🧳 everyone 🫂 down 😩 bad 😩.

The major 🏙️ east 🧭 coast 🌊 disruption 🌪️ struck ⚡ after the damaged 🔌 cable 🔌 wrecked 💥 the Terminal 🛬 Radar 📡 Approach 🛫 Control 🎛️ system 🖥️ which guides ✈️ planes 🛫 during takeoff 🛫 and landing 🛬 transport 🚉 officials 👔 confirmed 📝. New 🗽 Jersey 🗽 public 🚌 transportation 🚉 agency 🏛️ NJ 🗽 Transit 🚆 admitted 🙇 their own 🏗️ construction 🧱 workers 🧱 had accidentally 🔨 severed ✂️ the line 📡 after markers 🚩 were wrongly ❌ placed 📍 at the digging 🕳️ site 🏗️!! The BBC 📻 has reached 🤙 out 📞 to NJ 🗽 Transit 🚆 for comment 💬 while earlier 🕒 Duffy 🧔 blamed 🫵 workers 🧱 from Amtrak 🚄 the US 🦅 national 🇺🇸 intercity 🚅 railroad 🚂 operator 🧳 saying they caused 📡 a telecom 📡 outage 🌐 which forced ⚡ the FAA ✈️ to ground 🛑 flights 🛫 Duffy 🧔 posted 📱 on X 🐦. An Amtrak 🚄 spokesperson 🗣️ clarified 🧐 the incident 🛠️ actually involved a NJ 🗽 Transit 🚆 contractor 🤝 while Verizon 📶 which owns 🔌 the cable 🔌 insisted 🙅 they bore zero ❌ responsibility 🧾 for the backup 📡 network 🖧 error ❌ that only got discovered 🔎 after the primary 🔴 circuit ❌ failed 💥 according to FAA ✈️ head 🧠 Bryan 🧔 Bedford 🧔.

Newark 🛬 Liberty 🗽 International 🌍 Airport 🛫 in New 🗽 Jersey 🗽 one of the three 3️⃣ major 🏆 airports 🛬 serving New 🗽 York 🗽 City 🌆 was the most HEAVILY 🏋️‍♂️ impacted 💥 by today's 🗓️ air 🛫 traffic 🧭 control 🎛️ disruptions 🌪️ according to flight 🛫 tracking 📊 website 🌐 FlightAware 📈. It reported 📝 that two 🕛 six 🕕 seven 7️⃣ departing 🛫 flights 🛫 were delayed ⏳ today 🗓️ while a further two 🕛 five 🕠 seven 7️⃣ flights 🛬 destined for Newark 🛬 were also delayed ⏳!! John 🧔 F 🧔 Kennedy ✈️ International 🌍 Airport 🛬 and LaGuardia 🛫 Airport 🛬 both in New 🗽 York 🗽 were also affected 😣 as was Philadelphia 🛫 International 🌍 Airport 🛬. One 😶 passenger 🧳 Douglas 🧔 Tewnion 🧔 said he boarded 🛫 a flight ✈️ to New 🗽 York 🗽 from Edinburgh 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 and that his plane 🛫 had been diverted 🔀 to Boston 🦞 Massachusetts 🦞 instead 🔄.

He told 🗣️ the BBC 📻 that two 🕒 hours 🕒 after his flight ✈️ was due ⏰ into New 🗽 York 🗽 he and the other passengers 🧳 were still "sitting 🪑 on the same plane 🛫 on the tarmac 🛣️ at Boston 🦞 with no information 📡"!! Though "everyone is in good spirits 😌" Tewnion 🧔 said "it's just a pain 😣" to see two 🕒 more hours 🕒 waiting ⏳ added ➕ onto a lengthy 🕒 flight ✈️. The cable 🔌 had been repaired 🔧 and airports 🛬 are resuming 🟢 normal 🧭 operations 🛫 the US 🦅 transportation 🚉 secretary 🧳 says 📢. Flights 🛫 resumed 🟢 at New 🗽 York's 🗽 LaGuardia 🛫 Airport 🛬 and other airports 🛬 Monday 🌙 evening 🌆 after the disruption 🌪️ finally ended 🛑.

Hours 🕒 later 🚨 US 🦅 Transportation 🚉 Secretary 🧳 Sean 🧔 Duffy 🧔 said 📢 the cable 🔌 had been repaired 🔧 and airports 🛬 would resume 🟢 normal 🧭 operations 🛫 though delays ⏳ were still expected 😩!! The major 🏙️ east 🧭 coast 🌊 disruption 🌪️ came ahead of the UN 🕊️ General 🏛️ Assembly 🗣️ in New 🗽 York 🗽 City 🌆 on Tuesday 🗓️ which is expected 🤝 to be attended 👥 by scores 🏆 of world 🌍 leaders 👔 arriving ✈️ into New 🗽 York 🗽 area 🗺️ airports 🛬. That includes UK 🇬🇧 Prime 👑 Minister 👔 Andy 🧔 Burnham 🧔 who managed 🤝 to board 🛫 his flight ✈️ before the delays ⏳ began 🕒 and arrived 🛬 as planned 📅. The delays ⏳ happened 🕒 after the damaged 🔌 cable 🔌 impacted 💥 the Terminal 🛬 Radar 📡 Approach 🛫 Control 🎛️ system 🖥️ which is used 🛠️ to guide ✈️ planes 🛫 during takeoff 🛫 and landing 🛬 transport 🚉 officials 👔 said 📢.
